summary: Feed s179_triple to IDS is degraded with 3 high-severity faults: 83.2% encrypted traffic exceeds 60% IDS tolerance, required VLAN 20 missing with 49% packets untagged, and 9.2% TCP packet drops (233/2523). IDS needs full payload and VLAN context; current feed blinds detection.

findings.root_cause: 83.2% of bytes are encrypted vs 60% IDS tolerance. Traffic is predominantly TLS/encrypted without broker-side decryption or selective bypass, so IDS sees ciphertext only.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload for signature and anomaly detection; with 83% encrypted, payload inspection, file extraction and exploit detection are largely blind, sharply reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypt relevant TLS at broker/proxy and forward cleartext to IDS, or route undecryptable traffic to metadata-only path, to bring encrypted share below 60% IDS tolerance and restore payload visibility.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 not seen and 49% of packets are untagged. Packet broker or TAP/SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20 to this IDS feed.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20 for tenant/segment context and policy. Missing VLAN 20 causes misclassification, missed VLAN-specific rules, and loss of 49% visibility for untagged traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Configure broker ingress and egress to preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward VLANs 10 and 20 to s179_triple so IDS receives correct segmentation context.

findings.root_cause: 9.24% TCP packet loss (233 of 2523 packets with gaps/retransmissions) indicates SPAN oversubscription or packet broker buffer drops before the 1 Gbps IDS port. Tool overload check is healthy, so loss is upstream of tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs both directions and full payload for stream reassembly. 9% gaps break TCP reassembly, cause missed signatures, evasion opportunities, and incomplete flow records.

recommended_fix.why: Reduce loss by fixing SPAN oversubscription (prefer TAP or broker aggregation) and load-balancing the feed across additional IDS ports or broker egress with 5-tuple hashing to stay within 1 Gbps per port.
